title: User Management System — Business Requirements Document
summary: This BRD defines requirements for a user management system enabling admin, manager, and end-user roles to manage accounts, permissions, and audit logs.

requirements.title: User Login with Username and Password
requirements.description: The system shall allow registered users to log in using their username and password. The system must validate credentials against the database and grant role-based access upon success.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in with valid credentials
System rejects invalid credentials with error message
User is redirected to role-specific dashboard after login

requirements.title: Admin Can Create New User Accounts
requirements.description: Admin users shall be able to create new user accounts by providing full name, email address, role, and an initial password. The system must send a welcome email upon account creation.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can navigate to Users > Add User
Form accepts: Full Name, Email, Role, Password
Welcome email is sent on success

requirements.title: Password Must Meet Complexity Requirements
requirements.description: Passwords must be at least 8 characters, contain at least one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character.
acceptance_criteria: Error message shown for non-compliant passwords

requirements.title: Manager Can View Audit Logs
requirements.description: Managers shall have read-only access to the audit log showing all actions performed in the system.
acceptance_criteria: Audit log is accessible from Reports > Audit Log
Manager cannot modify audit log entries

requirements.title: System Should Notify Users
requirements.description: The system should notify users when important events happen.
requirements.vague_reason: Requirement is vague: it does not specify which events trigger notifications, what channels (email, in-app, SMS) are used, or what the notification content should be.
